title: USA Protection
author: Regretn
description: Private v1 for ChatWarden rc46+. Broad optional coverage of insults toward Americans and the USA: direct abuse, hostile slogans, country put-downs and internet slang. Strong matches hide; weaker satire or ambiguous slang may redact or warn. Context can lower scores. Ordinary nationality, USA, Yank and burger mentions alone are not rules. Gommage also masks the separate explicit-slur list. English and selected ASCII/transliterated phrases; not a semantic or multilingual guarantee.
